Although we have backup power for most situations, it does not sustain air conditioning and could be unavailable for some of the outage. By booking at Kenyaways, you acknowledge these circumstances are beyond our control. We cannot be held responsible for any inconvenience caused and do not offer refunds, credit vouchers, or discounts.</p>
